source: GROUND.md §6.3 (Fit) and decisions J1–J9. How art/import/building_fit.py fits every building piece's drawn mesh, in every grade and level of detail, to its logical slot (the module sizes in game/data/ground/building.json, where its collision and sockets are): the mesh is measured face by face against the slot and moved onto it, so no piece stops short of a neighbour (a gap) and no two neighbours' drawn faces lie in one plane (z-fighting). Collision, sockets and stability never move. Distances in metres.

measure.note: Points every 6 mm over the mesh's triangles (finer than a bin, so a thin branch along a face fills every bin); a face is measured in 1 cm bins along it (9 cm at a slab edge's corners and 2 cm at the ends of a wall's solid parts left out); its reach is how far past the logical face the mesh gets in a bin, positive beyond it. A face's robust reach is a percentile over its bins (faces' 'percentile').

slab top.note: the walking surface: the level most of the deck reaches, onto the slot's top; a slab's base is nobody's joint

slab edge.note: nine bins in ten reach the edge: neighbours meet, back to back

wall top.note: what stands on a wall covers its top: nine bins in ten stay under it

walls.note: After the fit every wall is drawn 3 mm lower, so its base tucks into what it stands on and whatever stands on its top (a floor, a roof's eave, the next wall) is the drawn face there. Within 30 cm of each end its top and base sink a further 0-4 mm toward the end, so two walls meeting at a corner or a T (the overlap reaches 26 cm along a wall at a 60° corner) have their tops in different planes, and the end leans 2 cm a metre about the wall's middle (x += 0.02 z, ±3 mm at its faces), so a floor's or foundation's side never lies in the plane of a wall's end. The same shape on every wall, either way round: stacked walls and walls in line still meet exactly.

twig.note: twig's crooked, round branches: joints reach 8 mm past the slot so their irregularity never opens a gap; round against round never lies in one plane

corners.note: Corner posts (building_kit.corner, drawn by the renderer's CornerPosts wherever walls meet at an angle): one for each interior angle two walls can meet at (a triangle's 60, a square's 90, two triangles' 120, a square and a triangle's 150) and each wall height, a millimetre inside the walls' outside faces and ends. Twig's round end posts already close its corners.

levels.note: Levels of detail the fit can't mend, left out so the game draws the next finer level there: the kit's 45 % decimation broke the stone floor frames' outline (6 cm short). It also sank most of the stone slabs' tiles 1.5-2 cm into their bed; that level is kept, the fit lifting its top onto the slot like any other (what it leaves uneven is a sixth of a pixel at 64 m, where the level starts), since drawing level 1 there instead would double the slabs' triangles at a distance.

limitNote: No face moves further than 8 cm: a measurement past that is reported and left alone (a broken level of detail is mended at its source, not stretched).
